ModMetaData.name: JustStorytellers
ModMetaData.author: tiagocc0
ModMetaData.description:
A retexture of the storytellers, using AI and some retouch here and there. On 1.7 there is also an alternative version of each one. Now you are able to replace any storyteller image, original or from other mods. It lets you select from images from other mods or from a folder so you can put your own images. For your own images, 580x620 fits best, and it lets you choose the small face version of the image as well by moving the square and using the scroll to zoom in and out. You can also hide my 6 alt versions with a checkbox if you want.
Non Steam version: https://github.com/purpleorangegames/JustStorytellers
